findings.title: Temporary and worktree installations pass the persistent-service preflight
findings.evidence: The only installation checks are a site-packages path component and containment in sys.prefix. The persistent definition then uses sys.executable with RunAtLoad and KeepAlive.
findings.counterexample: An installed package under /tmp/review-venv/lib/python3.13/site-packages or /Users/mitch/dev/worktrees/review/.venv/lib/python3.13/site-packages passes both checks. Removing that temporary environment leaves the launch agent pointing at a deleted interpreter/package.
findings.impact: A review environment can become the persistent service owner and break after ordinary temporary-worktree cleanup. This reduces installation robustness.
findings.prescribed_fix: Apply the stable installed-prefix guard already present in ecosystem/pipeline_service.py:69-82 before any install/status mutation. Keep system interpreter symlink handling compatible with an owned venv.
findings.test_prescription: Mock __file__ and sys.prefix to site-packages under /tmp, /private/tmp, /var/folders, worktrees and .worktrees; install must refuse before registered(), plist creation or launchctl bootstrap.
findings.status: Applied; empirical verification pending parent guarded test run

findings.title: Unconfirmed installation returns CLI success
findings.evidence: operate returns {installed: registered(target)} without raising when false. main lines 118-119 always emits ok:true and returns 0 for that result.
findings.counterexample: First registered(target) is false, bootstrap returns success, and final registered(target) is false. The resulting CLI response is ok:true with installed:false and exit status 0.
findings.impact: Automation accepts a failed/unconfirmed install as success and may continue while the requested display service is absent.
findings.prescribed_fix: Require final registered(target) to be true and raise a stable forecast_start_unconfirmed error otherwise, matching ecosystem/pipeline_service.py:125-126.
findings.test_prescription: Mock the registration sequence [False, False] with successful bootstrap. Assert install returns nonzero and ok:false; retain the owned plist for recoverable diagnosis.
findings.status: Applied; empirical verification pending parent guarded test run

findings.title: Different spellings of the same home produce duplicate service identities
findings.evidence: Path.absolute() preserves parent traversal and symlink aliases. definition line 19 hashes the uncanonicalized home through pipeline_label.
findings.counterexample: For an owned existing /Users/mitch/.oraclebot-state directory, --home /Users/mitch/.oraclebot-state and --home /Users/mitch/.oraclebot-state/../.oraclebot-state pass validation but hash to different labels and plist paths.
findings.impact: Two KeepAlive evaluators can operate on the same state directory because the ownership key is the path spelling rather than directory identity. No corruption claim is made without reviewing the evaluator.
findings.prescribed_fix: Reject a symlink supplied as the final home component, then canonicalize the owned home before generating its label and definition. Preserve a clear conflict/migration path for any existing noncanonical definition.
findings.test_prescription: Assert canonical and parent-traversal aliases resolve to one forecast label and cannot bootstrap a second owner; separately assert a final-component symlink remains refused.
findings.status: Applied; empirical verification pending parent guarded test run

findings.title: Preflight and launchctl failure reasons are discarded
findings.evidence: All OSError, ValueError and subprocess.SubprocessError branches are reduced to the same forecast_service_unavailable string. Specific safe ValueError codes and failing launchctl operation are lost.
findings.counterexample: owned_macos_home_required, immutable_installed_evaluator_required, forecast_service_identity_conflict and a missing launchctl executable all produce indistinguishable output and no diagnostic channel.
findings.impact: The owner cannot identify the exact missing prerequisite or repair a definition conflict from CLI output. This fails M5 E5 and removes the only observable failure cause from these service lifecycle paths.
findings.prescribed_fix: Map known preflight failures and lifecycle operations to bounded safe public error codes with actionable remediation. Keep raw subprocess output, sensitive paths and exception text out of the response.
findings.test_prescription: Assert distinct safe diagnostics for invalid home, unstable install, definition conflict and launchctl absence/failure; ensure stderr/stdout/exception strings containing synthetic secrets are not echoed.
findings.status: Applied; empirical verification pending parent guarded test run

excluded_candidates.title: Launchd log paths are not checked or made private
excluded_candidates.evidence: Umask is the only log protection. The home guard only checks owner/type; no path checks, ownership checks or chmod are applied to forecast-service.stdout.log or forecast-service.stderr.log before launchctl bootstrap.
excluded_candidates.counterexample: Use an owned mode-0755 home containing pre-existing mode-0644 forecast-service.stdout.log and forecast-service.stderr.log. Installation accepts them, and Umask does not change modes of existing files.
excluded_candidates.impact: Subsequent service output remains readable to other local users despite the private-log intent. Existing log symlinks and nonregular files are also accepted; no additional output-content or arbitrary-write claim is made.
excluded_candidates.prescribed_fix: Before bootstrap, create or validate each log as an owned regular nonsymlink file and enforce mode 0600; reject conflicts rather than following them. Do not silently chmod files not owned by the user.
excluded_candidates.test_prescription: Precreate owned 0644 logs and verify corrected private modes, then provide a symlink, FIFO and foreign-owned fixture and verify refusal before bootstrap.
excluded_candidates.status: Not raised as a confirmed finding; no change authorized
excluded_candidates.qualification: Preexisting 0644 log modes are a concrete configuration trigger, but this source-only audit did not establish private output content or a repository requirement that makes it a Medium-impact defect.
